initialBoards.name: territory-atlas
initialBoards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: a high-fidelity design choice board for the existing WARLINE CAPTURE military strategy game, with TWO full landscape game UI screenshots, Skirmish above and Campaign below. Newly design both menus; do not repeat the rejected saga snake route. Input 1 is the ACTUAL OPERATIONS menu: this is the authoritative visual design system for all chrome, zone division, illustrated icons, Oxanium-style typography, button faces, flat dark steel panels, crisp borders and realistic desert city map art. Input 2 is the ACTUAL CAMPAIGN menu: existing chapter and mission content reference, not a layout to copy. Both screens must look like siblings of Operations.
Board composition: square high-resolution presentation, two large complete 20:9 screens stacked, each with a small external plain white caption. Maximize screen area, no devices, no perspective, no mood-board fragments. Render readable big text and crisp UI, polished plausible Unity mobile/desktop game interface.
REQUIRED identical shared UI in both screenshots and ALL variants: top-left rectangular BACK button with the SAME illustrated tan left arrow, uppercase white BACK text, dimensions, neutral near-black vertical gradient, 2px cool steel border, and 24px outer margin as actual Operations. Place BACK only at top-left; never repeat in footer. The header has a white mode title next to BACK, gear and credits in matching top-right chips. No large Warline logo consuming the navigation bar. Header height about 96 logical px at 1080 reference height. Use Oxanium medium/bold consistently, readable normal body about 32px, secondary labels at least 26px, no tiny prototype text. Consistent panel gutters 16px and inner padding 24px. All command buttons share the same height about 132px, 2px crisp border, illustrated icon scale and gradient. Primary START BATTLE / START BRIEFING green, secondary THEATRE MAP / STORY ARCHIVE blue, tertiary neutral charcoal. No gold/yellow rectangular panel outlines; color is reserved for meaningful map regions and state accents. Selected UI uses Operations cyan. All panels consistent dark blue-black (#071216), subdued backgrounds, white readable body.
MAPS: use actual Operations' way of dividing ONE continuous existing desert city map into adjacent irregular polygon zones with SHARED BOUNDARIES and subtle transparent blue/green/ochre/red fills. Crisp 2px flat outlines; geography remains clear. No glowing island blobs, no halos, no neon, no separate framed terrain postcards, no winding numbered path, no disconnected territory islands. These are menu navigation overlays on existing Campaign art; do not imply new physical gameplay maps.
Use real established names, avoid invented campaign story: Skirmish battlefield groups DESERT BASE, CITY CROSSROADS, MOUNTAIN PASS, INDUSTRIAL BASIN, AIRFIELD PLAINS. Four Skirmish objective families BASE ASSAULT, FRONTLINE CONTROL, BREAKTHROUGH, CONVOY ESCORT. Mission S002 / BASE ASSAULT, description 'Secure the highway. Protect your base.' Campaign chapters FIRST RESPONSE, BROKEN GRID, HIDDEN NETWORK, AIR AND ARMOR, CITYWIDE COMMAND. Selected CHAPTER III / MISSION 03 / FALSE FRONT. Briefing 'Protect the evacuation. Identify the ambush.' Example progress is concept-only. Retain visible mission purpose, objective, selected mission and clear next player action. No fictional currencies, new game mechanics, developer controls, placeholder lorem ipsum or fake readiness claims.

DIRECTION A — TERRITORY ATLAS. Captions outside screenshots: 'A · SKIRMISH — TERRITORY ATLAS' and 'A · CAMPAIGN — CHAPTER ATLAS'.
Both screens use a clean large atlas plus right mission drawer. Left 16% width: five substantial navigation rows in Operations-style dark panels. Center 56%: one continuous city map split into five bordering districts using the Operations partition language, bold readable district name plaques with a small illustrated identity icon. Right 28%: a balanced selected-district mission drawer, six sizable mission selector rows or numbered tiles, the selected mission title and a compact actual map preview, one sentence of purpose, difficulty/medal selection. No mission card hovering over another zone.
Top Skirmish left list is the five battlefield groups, center same five bordering logical navigation territories, selected DESERT BASE cyan. Right drawer headed DESERT BASE with four readable objective tabs (two by two) and six Base Assault missions 01–06, selected S002, two concise mission lines and four readable medal choices.
Bottom Campaign left is the five chapter rows with subtle chapter art and completed/locked state; center atlas splits the city into five chapter districts, selected HIDDEN NETWORK cyan. Right drawer headed CHAPTER III, five mission rows 01–05 with mission03 FALSE FRONT highlighted; actual preview and purpose. No five-node half-snake.
Footer in each only two commands, secondary blue at left third and green primary at right two-thirds. Blue labels 'THEATRE MAP' for Skirmish, 'STORY ARCHIVE' for Campaign; green labels 'START BATTLE' and 'START BRIEFING'. Same exact component style and size. Emphasize calm hierarchy and large readable selection controls.
